feed.title: ENTITY Project Updates
feed.subtitle: Release, qualification and technical documentation updates for ENTITY by Blackmore Technology Group Limited.

entry.title: ENTITY standards and interoperability pre-submission working draft
entry.summary: Open technical material for review of provider-neutral authority, provenance, rights, portable state and conformance boundaries. The material is pre-submission and carries no IETF, W3C, DIF or other standards-body endorsement.

entry.title: External v3.4.2 economic counterexample accepted for follow-up qualification
entry.summary: An outside reviewer identified a source-level evidence-substitution replay counterexample in derivative-revenue deduplication. BTG confirmed the source boundary and recorded the contribution while preserving the immutable v3.4.2 release and distinguishing source analysis from runtime reproduction.

entry.title: ENTITY v3.4.2 — Canonical BTDU Release
entry.summary: ENTITY v3.4.2 is the current supported canonical release, introducing BTDU while preserving ENTITY authority, rights, provenance, recovery and economic semantics.

entry.title: ENTITY v3.4.2 External Qualification Program
entry.summary: Open external qualification calls cover hardware-backed key custody, physical multi-host operation, certified-device testing, independent security audit and independent assessor review.

entry.title: External Verification Challenge — reproduce it, break it, or implement one part independently
entry.summary: A public entry point for outside engineers to audit onboarding, reproduce sealed campaigns, test domain packages, review BTDU boundaries or implement a protocol component independently.

entry.title: AI Governance and Provenance Guide
entry.summary: A technical guide to explicit delegated authority, data/model lineage, evidence boundaries, training/derivation rights and independent scrutiny for governed AI systems.

entry.title: ENTITY Technical Guides
entry.summary: Problem-focused guides for data provenance, sovereign data rights, BTDU versus knowledge graphs/vector indexes, portable digital authority/recovery, and AI governance/provenance.
